headline: Never forget when NBA Youngboy ended his live after he realized nearly 200K people were wa
body:
Never forget when NBA Youngboy ended his live after he realized nearly 200K people were watching him 😭😂😂

Despite pulling in billions of views and streams, NBA YoungBoy has no interest in the spotlight. 🌍

He’s one of the most-streamed rappers in the world, with over 11 billion YouTube views and billions more across Spotify, yet he still prefers to live quietly in Utah, far away from the music industry.

YoungBoy records most of his music straight from home, saying he enjoys the peace and focus that come with staying out of the public eye. Even when nearly 200,000 people joined his Instagram Live, he ended it moments later
